title.zh: 卷390 列傳一百七十七 贾桢 周祖培 朱凤标 单懋谦
title.en: Volume 390 Biographies 177: Jia Zhen, Zhou Zupei, Zhu Fengbiao, Dan Maoqian
title.raw: 卷390 列傳一百七十七 贾桢 周祖培 朱凤标 单懋谦

sentences.zh: 賈楨，字筠堂，山東黃縣人。

translations.literal: Jia Zhen, style name Yuntang, was a native of Huang County in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhen, whose style was Yuntang, came from Huang County in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 父允升，乾隆六十年進士，由檢討歷官兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: His father Yun Sheng passed the jinshi examination in the sixtieth year of the Qianlong reign and rose from reviser to vice minister of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yun Sheng took his jinshi degree in the sixtieth year of Qianlong and advanced from reviser to vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 楨，一甲二名進士，授編修。

translations.literal: Zhen placed second in the first class of jinshi graduates and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhen ranked second in the first class of the jinshi examination and was appointed a Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 十三年，大考一等，擢侍講。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he received top grade in the major examination and was promoted to expositor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he earned top marks in the palace examination and was promoted to expositor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 十六年，入直上書房，授皇六子讀。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he entered the Imperial Study and was appointed tutor to the sixth imperial son.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he entered the Imperial Study and became tutor to the sixth imperial son.

sentences.zh: 累擢侍講學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to expositor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in stages to expositor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 十九年，大考翰詹，命免試。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, in the examination of Hanlin and Hanlin Academy officials, he was ordered exempted from testing.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, when the Hanlin corps was examined, he was excused from taking the test.

sentences.zh: 歷少詹事、內閣學士。

translations.literal: He served successively as junior tutor to the heir apparent and as a Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as junior tutor to the heir apparent and as a Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，遷工部侍郎，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to vice minister of the Ministry of Works and then to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was made vice minister of works, then transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，連擢左都御史、禮部尚書，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted in succession to left censor-in-chief, minister of rites, and then transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted in quick succession to left censor-in-chief and minister of rites, then moved to head the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he was appointed assistant grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng he was made assistant grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 三年，疏請山東籌辦團練，從之。

translations.literal: In the third year he memorialized requesting that Shandong organize militia training; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he submitted a memorial asking that Shandong organize local militia training, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 題孝和睿皇后神主禮成，加太子太保。

translations.literal: When the rites for inscribing the spirit tablet of Empress Xiaohui Rui were completed, he was given the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: After the ceremony installing the spirit tablet of Empress Xiaohui Rui was completed, he was granted the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 充上書房總師傅，兼管順天府尹。

translations.literal: He was appointed chief tutor of the Imperial Study and concurrently supervised the Shuntian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He served as chief tutor of the Imperial Study while also supervising the Shuntian prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was additionally appointed chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he also became chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 順天府書吏範鶴等與戶部井田科銀庫書吏交結營私，以鈔票抵庫銀。

translations.literal: The Shuntian prefectural clerks Fan He and others colluded with clerks of the Well-Field Section silver vault of the Ministry of Revenue for private gain, substituting bank notes for treasury silver.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian clerks led by Fan He had colluded with clerks in the Ministry of Revenue's Well-Field Section silver vault, using bank notes in place of treasury silver for private profit.

sentences.zh: 楨察舉其弊，讞定，譴失察諸官有差。

translations.literal: Zhen investigated and exposed the abuse; the case was adjudicated, and officials who had failed in oversight were censured to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhen exposed the fraud; once the case was decided, officials who had failed to detect it were punished according to their degree of negligence.

sentences.zh: 楨以發覺察議，拜體仁閣大學士，管理戶部。

translations.literal: For uncovering the fraud Zhen was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall and placed in charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had uncovered the scandal, Jia Zhen was made grand secretary of the Tiren Hall and put in charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 五年，兼管工部，晉武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was additionally placed in charge of the Ministry of Works and promoted to grand secretary of the Wuying Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he also took charge of the Ministry of Works and was promoted to grand secretary of the Wuying Hall.

sentences.zh: 六年，丁母憂，命暫開缺，給假六月回籍治喪，假滿來京。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, upon his mother's death, he was ordered to leave his post temporarily, granted six months' leave to return home for the funeral, and to come back to the capital when the leave expired.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when his mother died, he was allowed to vacate his post temporarily, given six months' leave to return home for the mourning rites, and told to report back to the capital when the leave ended.

sentences.zh: 楨疏言：「臣兄弟五人，諸昆疊故，臣幸僅存。

translations.literal: Zhen memorialized: "Your servant had five brothers; my elder brothers died one after another, and your servant alone survives by fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhen memorialized: "I had five brothers; one after another they died, and I alone am left.

sentences.zh: 今不能為母守制，是臣母有子而如無子，臣何以為子？

translations.literal: If I cannot now observe mourning for my mother, then my mother has a son as though she had none—how can I be called a son?
translations.idiomatic: If I cannot now observe the full mourning for my mother, she has a son in name only; how can I still call myself her son?

sentences.zh: 」力求終制。

translations.literal: " He earnestly begged to complete the full mourning period.
translations.idiomatic: " He pleaded earnestly to be allowed to complete the full three-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 時御史鄒焌傑亦疏請准其開缺守制，詔允之。

translations.literal: At the time the censor Zou Junjie also memorialized asking that he be allowed to leave office and observe mourning; an edict approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: The censor Zou Junjie also memorialized asking that Jia Zhen be released from office to observe mourning, and the throne granted it.

sentences.zh: 八年，服闋，以大學士銜補吏部尚書，仍充上書房總師傅。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, when mourning ended, he was appointed minister of personnel with the rank of grand secretary and continued as chief tutor of the Imperial Study.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, when his mourning ended, he was appointed minister of personnel with grand-secretary rank while continuing as chief tutor of the Imperial Study.

sentences.zh: 尋复授體仁閣大學士，管理兵部，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was again appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall, placed in charge of the Ministry of War, and concurrently made chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was again made grand secretary of the Tiren Hall, put in charge of the Ministry of War, and also reappointed chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 十年，充京城團防大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed a metropolitan militia defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was made a commissioner for the capital's militia defense.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，英法聯軍犯京師，車駕幸熱河，命楨留守，日危坐天安門，阻外軍不令入。

translations.literal: That autumn the Anglo-French allied armies attacked the capital; the imperial carriage went to Rehe, and Zhen was ordered to remain on guard. Each day he sat upright at Tian'an Gate and barred the foreign troops from entering.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, when the Anglo-French allied forces reached the capital and the court withdrew to Rehe, Jia Zhen was left in charge. Day after day he sat at Tian'an Gate and kept the foreign armies from entering the city.

sentences.zh: 及與會議，慷慨不屈。

translations.literal: When negotiations were held, he was forthright and unyielding.
translations.idiomatic: In the negotiations that followed, he spoke with force and refused to yield.

sentences.zh: 十一年，复晉武英殿大學士，以病請開缺，不許。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was again promoted to grand secretary of the Wuying Hall; he asked to leave office on grounds of illness, but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was again promoted to grand secretary of the Wuying Hall. He asked to resign on account of illness, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 穆宗回鑾，偕大學士周祖培，尚書沈兆霖、趙光上疏曰：「我朝從無皇太后垂簾聽政之典。

translations.literal: When the Muzong Emperor returned to the capital, together with Grand Secretary Zhou Zupei and the ministers Shen Zhaolin and Zhao Guang he submitted a memorial saying: "Our dynasty has never had the institution of the empress dowager ruling from behind a screen.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tongzhi Emperor returned to the capital, Jia Zhen joined Grand Secretary Zhou Zupei and Ministers Shen Zhaolin and Zhao Guang in a memorial that began: "Our dynasty has never had the institution of the empress dowager ruling from behind a curtain.

sentences.zh: 前因御史董元醇條奏，特降諭旨甚明，臣等復有何異詞。

translations.literal: Earlier, because the censor Dong Yuanchun submitted a detailed memorial, a special edict was issued that was very clear; what further dissent could your servants have?
translations.idiomatic: When the censor Dong Yuanchun raised the matter earlier, the throne issued a very clear edict; we have no further objection on that score.

sentences.zh: 惟是權不可下移，移則日替；

translations.literal: Only authority must not be shifted downward; if shifted, it daily declines;
translations.idiomatic: But authority must not be shifted downward, for once shifted it erodes day by day;

sentences.zh: 禮不可稍渝，渝則弊生。

translations.literal: and ritual must not be even slightly altered, for if altered, abuses arise.
translations.idiomatic: and ritual must not be even slightly bent, for once bent, abuses follow.

sentences.zh: 皇上沖齡踐阼，欽奉先帝遺命，派怡親王載垣等八人讚襄政務。

translations.literal: The Emperor, still of tender years, has ascended the throne and reverently received the late emperor's testamentary command, appointing Prince Yi Zaiyuan and seven others to assist in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor is still a child on the throne. In obedience to the late emperor's dying command, Prince Yi Zaiyuan and seven others were appointed to assist in government.

sentences.zh: 兩月以來，用人行政，皆經該王大臣擬定諭旨，每日明發，均用禦賞同道堂圖章，共見共聞，內外咸相欽奉。

translations.literal: For two months appointments and administration have all been drafted as edicts by these princes and grandees, issued openly each day, all bearing the imperially bestowed Tongdao Hall seal—seen and heard by all, revered within and without.
translations.idiomatic: For two months every appointment and every administrative act has been drafted by these princes and ministers, promulgated daily under the imperial Tongdao Hall seal that all have seen and all obey, at court and in the provinces alike.

sentences.zh: 惟臣等詳慎思之，似非久遠萬全之策，不能謂日後之決無流弊。

translations.literal: Only your servants, reflecting carefully, find that this seems not a policy secure for the long term, and cannot say that abuses will certainly never arise hereafter.
translations.idiomatic: Yet on careful reflection we do not believe this can be a secure arrangement for the long term, and we cannot say that abuses will never follow.

sentences.zh: 尋繹贊襄之義，乃佐助而非主持。

translations.literal: Searching out the meaning of "assist," it is to aid, not to preside.
translations.idiomatic: The word "assist" means to help, not to rule in the emperor's place.

sentences.zh: 若事無鉅細，皆由該王大臣先行定議，是名為佐助而實則主持。

translations.literal: If matters great and small are all first decided by these princes and grandees, this is called assisting but in fact is presiding.
translations.idiomatic: If every matter, great or small, is decided first by these princes and ministers, they are called assistants but in fact they govern.

sentences.zh: 日久相沿，中外能無疑慮？

translations.literal: As days pass and the practice continues, can there be no doubts within and without?
translations.idiomatic: If this continues day after day, how can court and country not grow uneasy?

sentences.zh: 為今日計，正宜皇太后親操出治威權，庶臣工有所禀承，命令有所諮決，不居垂簾之虛名，而收聽政之實效。

translations.literal: For the present, it is fitting that the empress dowager personally wield the authority to govern, so that officials may have someone to report to and orders may be consulted and decided, not holding the empty title of ruling from behind a screen but gaining the real effect of hearing government.
translations.idiomatic: For the present, the empress dowager should herself exercise governing authority, so that officials know whom to answer to and commands have a place to be resolved—without taking the empty title of ruling from behind a curtain, yet with the real effect of governing.

sentences.zh: 準法前朝，憲章近代，不難折衷至當。

translations.literal: Taking earlier dynasties as models and recent precedents as standards, it would not be hard to strike a proper balance.
translations.idiomatic: With precedents from earlier dynasties and recent examples to guide us, a proper arrangement should not be difficult to devise.

sentences.zh: 伏查漢和熹鄧皇后、順烈梁皇后，晉康獻褚皇后，遼睿智蕭皇后皆以太后臨朝，史冊稱美。

translations.literal: Your servants find that Empress Deng of the Han Hexi reign, Empress Liang the Shunlie, Empress Chu the Kangxian of Jin, and Empress Xiao the Ruizhi of Liao all ruled as empress dowager at court, and the histories praise them.
translations.idiomatic: We find that Empress Deng of Han, Empress Liang, Empress Chu of Jin, and Empress Xiao of Liao all governed as empress dowagers, and the histories speak well of them.

sentences.zh: 至如宋之章獻劉皇后，有今世任姒之稱，宣仁高太后有女中堯舜之譽。

translations.literal: As for the Song, Empress Liu the Zhangxian was called a Ren Ji of the present age, and Empress Gao the Xuanren was praised as a Yao or Shun among women.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song, Empress Liu the Zhangxian was hailed as a Ren Ji reborn, and Empress Gao the Xuanren was praised as a Yao or Shun in woman's form.

sentences.zh: 明穆宗皇后，神宗嫡母，上尊號曰仁聖皇太后；

translations.literal: The empress of the Ming Muzong, the Shenzong Emperor's legal mother, was given the honorific title Ren Sheng Empress Dowager;
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming, the empress of the Muzong Emperor, who was the Shenzong Emperor's legal mother, was given the title Ren Sheng Empress Dowager;

sentences.zh: 穆宗貴妃，神宗生母，上尊號曰慈聖皇太后，惟時神宗十歲，政事皆由兩宮抉擇，命大臣施行，亦未嘗居垂簾之名也。

translations.literal: the Muzong Emperor's honored consort, the Shenzong Emperor's birth mother, was given the honorific title Ci Sheng Empress Dowager; at that time the Shenzong Emperor was ten years old, and all government affairs were decided by the two palaces and ordered carried out by grand ministers—they likewise never bore the name of ruling from behind a screen.
translations.idiomatic: while the honored consort who bore the Shenzong Emperor was given the title Ci Sheng Empress Dowager. The Shenzong Emperor was then only ten; the two empress dowagers decided affairs of state and had ministers execute them, yet they too never took the name of ruling from behind a curtain.

sentences.zh: 我皇上天亶聰明，不數年即可親政，而此數年間，外而寇難未平，內而洋人偪處，何以拯時艱？

translations.literal: Our Emperor is heaven-endowed with intelligence and in a few years can personally rule; yet in these few years, abroad bandit troubles are not pacified and at home foreigners press close—how can the times' hardships be saved?
translations.idiomatic: Our Emperor is gifted by Heaven and will rule in person within a few years; yet in the interval rebels still ravage the land and foreigners press upon us at home—how are we to meet this crisis?

sentences.zh: 何以飭法紀？

translations.literal: How can law and discipline be enforced?
translations.idiomatic: How are law and discipline to be upheld?

sentences.zh: 端以固結人心最為緊要。

translations.literal: Uprightness lies in binding hearts together—this is most urgent.
translations.idiomatic: What matters most is to hold the people's loyalty together through clear authority.

sentences.zh: 倘大權無所專屬，以致人心惶惑，是則大可憂者。

translations.literal: If great power has no fixed seat, causing hearts to waver in alarm, that is what is greatly to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: If supreme authority rests nowhere definite and the people grow anxious, that is what we must fear.

sentences.zh: 請敕下廷臣會議皇太后召見臣工禮節，及一切辦事章程，或仍循向來軍機大臣承旨舊制；

translations.literal: We ask that Your Majesty command the court to deliberate the ceremonial for the empress dowager's audiences with officials and all rules of procedure, or still follow the former practice of the Grand Council ministers receiving and transmitting edicts;
translations.idiomatic: We ask that Your Majesty order the court to deliberate the ceremonies for the empress dowager's audiences with officials and all rules of procedure, whether to retain the old system by which Grand Council ministers received and transmitted edicts;

sentences.zh: 量為變通，條列請旨酌定，以示遵守。

translations.literal: or make appropriate adjustments, set them out in articles, and request the throne to decide and fix them as rules to be observed.
translations.idiomatic: or adapt them as needed, set the details out in articles, and have the throne decide what shall be followed.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，命廷臣集議允行。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, the court was ordered to assemble for deliberation and approval.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial reached the throne, the court was ordered to meet, deliberate, and carry out its recommendations.

sentences.zh: 周祖培，字芝台，河南商城人。

translations.literal: Zhou Zupei, style name Zhitan, was a native of Shangcheng in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Zupei, whose style was Zhitan, came from Shangcheng in Henan.

sentences.zh: 父鉞，嘉慶六年進士，歷官鴻臚寺少卿。

translations.literal: His father Yue passed the jinshi examination in the sixth year of Jiaqing and served as vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yue took his jinshi degree in the sixth year of Jiaqing and rose to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 祖培，進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: Zupei passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Zupei passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and was appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 五遷至侍講學士。

translations.literal: After five promotions he reached expositor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: After five promotions he became expositor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: ，督陝甘學政。

translations.literal: [Thereafter] he was appointed educational commissioner for Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed educational commissioner for Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 歷侍讀學士、詹事、內閣學士。

translations.literal: He served successively as reader of the Hanlin Academy, tutor to the heir apparent, and Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Hanlin reader, tutor to the heir apparent, and Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，擢禮部侍郎，調工部，又調刑部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was promoted to vice minister of rites, transferred to works, and then to punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was made vice minister of rites, then transferred to works and afterward to punishments.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，偕尚書賽尚阿查勘江南江防善後事宜，校閱江蘇、安徽、江西營伍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, together with the minister Sai Shang'a, he inspected the Yangtze defenses and post-crisis arrangements in Jiangnan and reviewed the garrisons of Jiangsu, Anhui, and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he joined Minister Sai Shang'a in inspecting Jiangnan's river defenses and follow-up measures, and in reviewing the troops of Jiangsu, Anhui, and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 三十年，文宗即位，疏言：「我朝立政之要，用人之法，備載列聖實錄，請隨時披閱。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, when the Wenzong Emperor ascended the throne, he memorialized: "The essentials of our dynasty's government and methods of employing men are fully recorded in the Veritable Records of successive sage emperors; please read them at all times.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, when the Xianfeng Emperor took the throne, he memorialized: "The essentials of government and the methods of appointing men in our dynasty are fully set out in the Veritable Records of the sage emperors; I beg Your Majesty to read them often.

sentences.zh: 利害所關，今昔同轍，容有昔之所利不盡利於今者，未有昔之所害不為害於今者；

translations.literal: Where benefit and harm are concerned, past and present follow the same track; there may be what was beneficial in the past that is not wholly beneficial today, but there is nothing harmful in the past that is not harmful today;
translations.idiomatic: Benefit and harm follow the same paths in every age. Something that helped in the past may not help fully today, but nothing that harmed the past fails to harm the present;

sentences.zh: 容有昔所欲除之害至今猶未盡除者，未有昔所應防之害至今轉可不防者。

translations.literal: there may be harms the past wished to remove that are not yet wholly removed today, but there is nothing the past should have guarded against that today may go unguarded.
translations.idiomatic: some evils the past tried to remove may still not be wholly gone, but no evil the past had to guard against can safely be left unguarded now.

sentences.zh: 惟皇上成法在胸，以應幾務，庶利害瞭如指掌，而興廢可決於一心。

translations.literal: Only if Your Majesty keeps established laws in mind to meet every affair will benefit and harm lie clear as on the palm, and what to advance or abolish be decided in a single resolve.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty keeps the established laws in mind when meeting each affair, benefit and harm will lie clear before you, and what to keep or abolish can be decided in one firm resolve.

sentences.zh: 並請責成大吏，力戒欺飾，考察屬吏；

translations.literal: We also ask that high officials be held responsible, strictly forbidden deception, and their subordinates examined;
translations.idiomatic: I also ask that high officials be held strictly accountable, forbidden to deceive, and made to examine their subordinates;

sentences.zh: 其徇隱庇護者，經言官彈劾，即嚴懲督撫，整頓營伍，責令捕盜，勿任推諉。

translations.literal: those who favor and shield them, once impeached by censors, should at once be severely punished; governors-general and governors should be disciplined, garrisons put in order, and ordered to capture bandits without allowing evasion of responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: and when they favor or shield wrongdoers, let censors impeach them and governors-general and governors be punished at once. Put the troops in order, order them to hunt down bandits, and allow no shirking of duty.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，被嘉納，特詔飭行。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, it was praised and accepted, and a special edict ordered its implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was well received, and a special edict ordered its recommendations carried out.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，擢刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he was promoted to minister of punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng he was promoted to minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 二年，疏言：「戶部籌餉二十馀條，所議之款，緩不濟急。

translations.literal: In the second year he memorialized: "The Ministry of Revenue's more than twenty articles for raising funds—the items discussed are too slow to meet urgent needs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he memorialized: "The Ministry of Revenue's more than twenty proposals for raising funds are too slow for the urgent need.

sentences.zh: 請照道光二十一年河南河工、城工捐輸章程，變通辦理。

translations.literal: Please follow the regulations for voluntary contributions to Henan river works and city works in the twenty-first year of Daoguang, with appropriate adaptations.
translations.idiomatic: Please adapt the voluntary-contribution regulations used for Henan river and city works in the twenty-first year of Daoguang.

sentences.zh: 」又謂：「按戶派捐，先斂怨於民。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Assessing contributions by household first breeds resentment among the people.
translations.idiomatic: " He also argued: "Levying contributions household by household only breeds popular resentment first.

sentences.zh: 請飭各督撫確查巨富之家，勸諭激發忠愛，力圖報效。

translations.literal: Please order each governor-general and governor to investigate truly wealthy families, exhort them, stir their loyal devotion, and urge them to strive to repay the state.
translations.idiomatic: Order each governor-general and governor to identify the truly wealthy, exhort them, awaken their loyal devotion, and urge them to serve the state.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 三年，要犯劉秋貴死於獄，承審官未得實情，祖培坐降三級調用，授左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the third year the major criminal Liu Qiugui died in prison; the examining officials had not obtained the true facts, and Zupei was demoted three ranks and transferred, then appointed left vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the major criminal Liu Qiugui died in prison before the examining officials had established the facts. Zhou Zupei was demoted three ranks and transferred, then appointed left vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「賊匪滋事以來，屢諭各省辦團練，築寨浚壕，仿嘉慶年間堅壁清野之法，行無實效，賊竄突靡定，各州縣毫無豫備，賊至即潰。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Since bandits have risen in disorder, the provinces have repeatedly been ordered to organize militia, build stockades, and dig moats, imitating the Jiaqing-era method of fortified villages and cleared countryside, yet in practice there has been no effect; bandits roam without fixed direction, each district and county is wholly unprepared, and when bandits arrive they collapse at once.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Since the rebels rose, the provinces have again and again been ordered to organize militia, build stockades, and dig moats on the Jiaqing model of fortified villages and cleared countryside, yet nothing effective has been done. The rebels roam at will, the districts are wholly unprepared, and at their approach the defenses collapse.

sentences.zh: 請嚴飭督撫，責成賢能有司，會紳速辦；

translations.literal: We ask that governors-general and governors be strictly ordered to hold capable officials responsible, join with local gentry, and carry this out swiftly;
translations.idiomatic: I ask that governors-general and governors be strictly ordered to put capable officials in charge, work with local gentry, and act at once;

sentences.zh: 有怠玩從事，反滋擾累者，予參處。

translations.literal: those who are negligent or merely go through the motions and instead increase harassment should be impeached and punished.
translations.idiomatic: and that any who are negligent or only add to the people's burdens be impeached and punished.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 歷工部、吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: He served successively as vice minister of works and of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as vice minister of works and of personnel.

sentences.zh: 四年，連擢左都御史、兵部尚書，兼管順天府尹。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted in succession to left censor-in-chief and minister of war, and concurrently supervised the Shuntian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was promoted in quick succession to left censor-in-chief and minister of war, while also supervising the Shuntian prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六年，宣宗實錄、聖訓成，加太子太保，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when the Xuanzong Emperor's Veritable Record and Sacred Instructions were completed, he was given the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when the Daoguang Emperor's Veritable Record and Sacred Instructions were completed, he was granted the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and moved to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 八年，會辦五城團防，以吏部尚書協辦大學士，兼署戶部。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he jointly managed the Five-Wards militia defense, served as assistant grand secretary with the rank of minister of personnel, and concurrently acted for the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he helped organize the Five-Wards militia defense, served as assistant grand secretary while minister of personnel, and also acted head of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 九年，調戶部，兼署吏部。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and concurrently acted for the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and also acted head of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 京師戒嚴，疏陳團防章程六條：曰查戶口以別良莠，勸保衛以聯眾志，任官紳以專責成，協營汛以聯臂指，設水會以備不虞，增幫辦以資助理。

translations.literal: When the capital was placed under martial law, he memorialized six articles for militia defense regulations: inspect households to distinguish good from bad; encourage defense to unite popular will; entrust officials and gentry with sole responsibility; coordinate garrison posts to act as one arm; establish water brigades against unforeseen events; and add assistants to supply support.
translations.idiomatic: When martial law was declared in the capital, he submitted six rules for militia defense: register households to separate the trustworthy from the suspect; encourage self-defense to unite public resolve; give officials and gentry clear responsibility; coordinate garrison posts so they act as one force; set up water brigades against fire and flood; and add assistants to help carry the work out.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸熱河，命留京辦事，拜體仁閣大學士，管理戶部。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage went to Rehe, he was ordered to remain in the capital to conduct affairs, appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall, and placed in charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When the court withdrew to Rehe, he was left in charge in the capital, made grand secretary of the Tiren Hall, and put at the head of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十一年，文宗崩，命總理喪儀，兼辦定陵平安峪工程。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the Wenzong Emperor died; he was ordered to direct the mourning rites and concurrently oversee the Dingling tomb works at Ping'anyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the Xianfeng Emperor died. Zhou Zupei was ordered to direct the mourning rites and also to oversee work on the Dingling tomb at Ping'anyu.

sentences.zh: 及穆宗奉兩宮回鑾，祖培疏言怡親王載垣等擬定「祺祥」年號，意義重複，請更正，詔嘉其關心典禮。

translations.literal: When the Muzong Emperor returned with the two palaces, Zupei memorialized that Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others had proposed the reign title "Qixiang," whose meaning was redundant, and asked that it be corrected; an edict praised his concern for ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tongzhi Emperor returned with the two empress dowagers, Zhou Zupei memorialized that Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others had proposed the reign title Qixiang, whose meaning was redundant, and asked that it be changed. An edict praised his attention to ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 又言近畿各處抗糧拒捕成風，由於州縣不得其人，諭各督撫秉公遴選，毋稍徇隱。

translations.literal: He also said that resistance to tax collection and arrest had become widespread in the capital region because the right men were not in the district posts, and ordered each governor-general and governor to select fairly without the least favoritism.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that tax resistance and defiance of arrest had become common near the capital because the wrong men held county posts, and the throne ordered each governor-general and governor to choose officials fairly and show no favoritism.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，調管刑部。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was transferred to head the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he was put in charge of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 四年，山陵告成，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when the imperial tomb was reported completed, he was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when the imperial tomb was completed, he was granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 五年，文宗實錄、聖訓成，賜其子文龠員外郎，文令舉人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, when the Wenzong Emperor's Veritable Record and Sacred Instructions were completed, his son Wen Yue was granted the post of vice director in a ministry and Wen Ling the rank of provincial graduate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, when the Xianfeng Emperor's Veritable Record and Sacred Instructions were completed, his son Wen Yue was given a vice-director post and Wen Ling the rank of provincial graduate.

sentences.zh: 六年，卒，年七十五，優恤，諡文勤。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he died at the age of seventy-five; he was given favored condolence payments and the posthumous title Wenqin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he died at seventy-five. The court granted him favored funeral honors and the posthumous title Wenqin.

sentences.zh: 朱鳳標，字桐軒，浙江蕭山人。

translations.literal: Zhu Fengbiao, style name Tongxuan, was a native of Xiaoshan in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Fengbiao, whose style was Tongxuan, came from Xiaoshan in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 一甲二名進士，授編修。

translations.literal: He placed second in the first class of jinshi graduates and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He ranked second in the first class of the jinshi examination and was appointed a Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 十九年，大考二等，賜文綺，直上書房。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he received second grade in the major examination, was granted patterned silk, and entered the Imperial Study.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he earned second grade in the palace examination, was granted patterned silk, and entered the Imperial Study.

sentences.zh: 尋督湖北學政。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed educational commissioner for Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed educational commissioner for Hubei.

sentences.zh: 歷司業、侍講、​​庶子、侍講學士、侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He served successively as vice director of the Directorate of Education, expositor, junior tutor to the heir apparent, expositor of the Hanlin Academy, and reader of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as vice director of the Directorate of Education, expositor, junior tutor to the heir apparent, expositor of the Hanlin Academy, and Hanlin reader.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，授皇七子讀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed tutor to the seventh imperial son.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he became tutor to the seventh imperial son.

sentences.zh: 連擢內閣學士、兵部侍郎，調戶部。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Grand Secretariat academician and vice minister of war, then transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in quick succession to Grand Secretariat academician and vice minister of war, then transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，命赴天津驗收漕糧。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was ordered to go to Tianjin to inspect and receive the grain tribute transported by the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was ordered to Tianjin to inspect receipt of canal tribute grain.

sentences.zh: 尋偕大學士耆英查辦山東鹽務，疏劾歷任巡撫、運司收受程儀節壽，論譴有差。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, together with Grand Secretary Qiying, he investigated Shandong salt administration; in a memorial he impeached successive governors and transport commissioners for accepting journey gratuities and birthday gifts, and punishments were meted out to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined Grand Secretary Qiying in investigating Shandong salt affairs. In a memorial he impeached successive governors and transport commissioners for accepting travel gratuities and birthday gifts, and they were censured to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 又言：「山東鹽政疲敝甚於他省，若求裕課暢銷，惟除弊、緝私最為先務。

translations.literal: He also said: "Shandong's salt administration is more exhausted and dilapidated than that of other provinces; if one seeks ample revenue and smooth sales, eliminating abuses and suppressing smuggling are the foremost tasks.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "Shandong's salt administration is more rundown than any other province's. To fill the revenue quota and keep salt moving, the first priority must be rooting out abuses and cracking down on smuggling.

sentences.zh: 會議變通成法，請先課后鹽以重帑項。

translations.literal: After conference on adapting established regulations, he requested levying the tax before distributing salt to strengthen treasury receipts.
translations.idiomatic: After deliberating on reforming the established rules, he proposed levying tax before distributing salt to boost treasury income.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was referred to the ministries for deliberation and carried out.

sentences.zh: 又查運庫出借銀七萬馀兩，責賠繳；

translations.literal: He also investigated more than seventy thousand taels of silver lent out from the transport treasury and ordered repayment;
translations.idiomatic: He also found more than seventy thousand taels of silver lent from the transport treasury and ordered it repaid;

sentences.zh: 籓庫積存減平及扣還軍需行裝等款三十萬兩，撥解部庫；

translations.literal: three hundred thousand taels accumulated in the provincial treasury from retained surplus fractions and recovered payments for military supplies and travel expenses were transferred to the central treasury;
translations.idiomatic: three hundred thousand taels held in the provincial treasury from retained weight surpluses and recovered military-supply and travel allowances were transferred to the central treasury;

sentences.zh: 通省倉庫正雜未完銀四十一萬兩，缺穀三十七萬石，命限八個月彌補。

translations.literal: throughout the province, principal and miscellaneous shortfalls in granaries amounted to four hundred ten thousand taels of silver and three hundred seventy thousand shi of grain; he was ordered to make them up within eight months.
translations.idiomatic: Shortfalls in silver and grain stores province-wide totaled four hundred ten thousand taels and three hundred seventy thousand shi; he was ordered to make good the losses within eight months.

sentences.zh: ，擢左都御史，歷署工部、刑部、戶部尚書。

translations.literal: , He was promoted to left censor-in-chief and served in succession as acting minister of works, punishments, and revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was then promoted to left censor-in-chief and served in turn as acting minister of works, punishments, and revenue.

sentences.zh: 三年，粵匪陷江寧，复陷揚州，漕督楊殿邦​​退保淮安，廷議調山西、陝西兵七千赴援。

translations.literal: In the third year the Taiping rebels took Jiangning and then Yangzhou; Grain Transport Commissioner Yang Dianbang withdrew to defend Huai'an, and the court debated sending seven thousand troops from Shanxi and Shaanxi to assist.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng the Taiping rebels took Nanjing and then Yangzhou. Grain Transport Commissioner Yang Dianbang fell back to Huai'an, and the court debated dispatching seven thousand men from Shanxi and Shaanxi to reinforce him.

sentences.zh: 鳳標與尚書文慶，侍郎全慶、王慶雲合疏，言：「淮安賊所必爭，萬一賊眾渡河，則河南、山東民情震動，撲滅愈難。

translations.literal: Fengbiao, together with Minister Wen Qing and Vice Ministers Quan Qing and Wang Qingyun, submitted a joint memorial saying: "Huai'an is a place the rebels are sure to contest; if by any chance a large rebel force crosses the river, the people of Henan and Shandong will be shaken, and suppression will become all the harder.
translations.idiomatic: Fengbiao joined Minister Wen Qing and Vice Ministers Quan Qing and Wang Qingyun in a joint memorial: "Huai'an is ground the rebels are bound to fight for. If their main force crosses the river, Henan and Shandong will be thrown into alarm and the rebels will become far harder to crush.

sentences.zh: 請命山東巡撫李僡親往淮安扼賊北竄，並請敕直隸總督迅派布政使張集馨率兵扼要駐守，以為京師屏蔽。

translations.literal: We ask that Shandong Governor Li Bin be ordered to go in person to Huai'an to block the rebels' flight north, and that the governor-general of Zhili be instructed to dispatch swiftly Intendant Zhang Jixin with troops to hold key positions as a shield for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that Governor Li Bin of Shandong be sent in person to Huai'an to block a northern break-out, and that the governor-general of Zhili be ordered to dispatch Intendant Zhang Jixin with troops to hold the critical passes and shield the capital.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，如所請行。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, the court acted as requested.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved and carried out as proposed.

sentences.zh: 五月，賊陷河南歸德，鳳標與大學士賈楨、尚書翁心存等條擬防剿六事，多被採擇。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the rebels took Guide in Henan; Fengbiao, together with Grand Secretary Jia Zhen, Minister Weng Xincun, and others, drafted six items on defense and suppression, many of which were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the rebels took Guide in Henan. Fengbiao, Grand Secretary Jia Zhen, Minister Weng Xincun, and others drafted six proposals for defense and suppression, many of which the court adopted.

sentences.zh: 未幾，悍賊林鳳祥等竄畿輔，复偕楨、心存等奏陳預籌守城事宜。

translations.literal: Before long the fierce rebels Lin Fengxiang and others fled into the capital region; he again joined Zhen, Xincun, and others in memorializing on advance preparations for defending the city.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the formidable rebel Lin Fengxiang and others broke into the capital region. Fengbiao again joined Jia Zhen, Weng Xincun, and others in memorializing on preparations for defending the city.

sentences.zh: 疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, the court acknowledged receipt.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was received and noted.

sentences.zh: 四年，授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed minister of punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was appointed minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 六年，宣宗實錄、聖訓告成，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when the Veritable Record and Sacred Instructions of the Xuanzong Emperor were completed, he was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when the Daoguang Emperor's Veritable Record and Sacred Instructions were completed, he was granted the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 尋調兵部，復調戶部。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to the Ministry of War and then again to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to the Ministry of War, then again to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八年，典順天鄉試，因中式舉人平齡朱墨不符，為言官論劾，興大獄，大學士柏葰論大辟，鳳標亦解任聽勘。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he presided over the Shuntian provincial examination; because the successful candidate Ping Ling's original and fair copies did not match, censorial officials impeached him, a major case arose, Grand Secretary Bai Jun was sentenced to death, and Fengbiao was also removed from office pending investigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he presided over the Shuntian provincial examination. When the successful candidate Ping Ling's original and fair copies did not match, censorial officials impeached those responsible and a major scandal erupted. Grand Secretary Bai Jun was sentenced to death in the Ping Ling case, and Fengbiao was also removed from office pending investigation.

sentences.zh: 文宗原其無私，從寬坐失察革職。

translations.literal: The Wenzong Emperor, considering that he had no private motive, leniently found him guilty only of failure to supervise and dismissed him from office.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianfeng Emperor, believing he had no private motive, treated him leniently and dismissed him only for failure to supervise.

sentences.zh: 逾數月，命以翰林院侍講學士銜，仍直上書房，授醇郡王讀如故。

translations.literal: After several months he was ordered to serve with the rank of expositor of the Hanlin Academy, still entering the Imperial Study and continuing to tutor Prince Chun as before.
translations.idiomatic: A few months later he was restored to the Hanlin with the rank of expositor, returned to the Imperial Study, and resumed tutoring Prince Chun as before.

sentences.zh: 歷大理寺少卿、通政使、左副都御史，署刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: He served successively as vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, commissioner of the Office of Transmission, left vice censor-in-chief, and acting vice minister of punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, commissioner of the Office of Transmission, left vice censor-in-chief, and acting vice minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 隨扈熱河，复擢兵部尚書。

translations.literal: He accompanied the imperial entourage to Rehe and was again promoted to minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: He accompanied the court to Rehe and was again promoted to minister of war.

sentences.zh: 十一年，護送文宗梓宮回京，追錄扈從勞，加二級。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he escorted the Wenzong Emperor's coffin back to the capital; his service in accompanying the entourage was recorded with merit, and he was granted two additional ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he escorted the Xianfeng Emperor's coffin back to Beijing. His service on the journey was recognized and he was granted two additional ranks.

sentences.zh: 調吏部，充上書房總師傅。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and appointed chief tutor of the Imperial Study.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and made chief tutor of the Imperial Study.

sentences.zh: ，以吏部尚書協辦大學士，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: , As minister of personnel he was appointed assistant grand secretary and concurrently made chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: As minister of personnel he was made assistant grand secretary and concurrently chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 未幾，拜體仁閣大學士，管理吏部。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall and placed in charge of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall and put in charge of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以病乞休，命以大學士致仕，食全俸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, citing illness, he requested retirement; he was ordered to retire as grand secretary on full salary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he asked to retire on grounds of illness and was permitted to leave office as grand secretary on full pay.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒於家，贈太子太保，諡文端。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died at home; he was posthumously granted the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he died at home. He was posthumously granted the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 子其煊，工部郎中，官至山東布政使。

translations.literal: His son Qi Xuan served as a director in the Ministry of Works and rose to provincial treasurer of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: His son Qi Xuan served as a director in the Ministry of Works and rose to provincial treasurer of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 單懋謙，字地山，湖北襄陽人。

translations.literal: Dan Maoqian, style name Dishan, was a native of Xiangyang in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Dan Maoqian, whose style was Dishan, came from Xiangyang in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: A jinshi graduate, he was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi graduate, he was chosen as a Hanlin bachelor and appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 十七年，入直南書房。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he entered service in the Southern Studio.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he entered service in the Southern Studio.

sentences.zh: 十九年，大考二等，以贊善升用。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he received second grade in the major examination and was promoted from tutor to the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he earned second grade in the palace examination and was promoted from tutor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 尋授司業，遷洗馬。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed vice director of the Directorate of Education and then transferred to groom of the heir apparent's palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made vice director of the Directorate of Education and then transferred to groom of the heir apparent's palace.

sentences.zh: 二十年，督廣東學政，歷侍讀、庶子。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was appointed educational commissioner for Guangdong and served successively as reader and junior tutor to the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was appointed educational commissioner for Guangdong and served in turn as Hanlin reader and junior tutor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 以病歸，父喪服闋，請終母養。

translations.literal: He returned home on account of illness; after his father's mourning period ended, he requested leave to complete his mother's care.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home on account of illness. When his period of mourning for his father ended, he asked for leave to care for his mother through her final days.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，粵匪擾湖北，懋謙方居母憂，命在籍治團練。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng the Taiping rebels harassed Hubei; Maoqian was then in mourning for his mother and was ordered to organize militia training while at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng the Taiping rebels raided Hubei. Maoqian was then in mourning for his mother and was ordered to organize local militia at home.

sentences.zh: 六年，回京，仍直南書房，補原官。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he returned to the capital, again served in the Southern Studio, and was restored to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he returned to the capital, resumed service in the Southern Studio, and was restored to his former post.

sentences.zh: 七年，督江西學政，歷侍讀學士、少詹事、內閣學士、工部侍郎，均留學政任。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed educational commissioner for Jiangxi; he served successively as reader of the Hanlin Academy, junior tutor to the heir apparent, Grand Secretariat academician, and vice minister of works, each time retaining his post as educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed educational commissioner for Jiangxi. He was promoted in turn to Hanlin reader, junior tutor to the heir apparent, Grand Secretariat academician, and vice minister of works, each time while keeping his post as educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一年，巡撫毓科、布政使慶廉為言官論劾，命懋謙按之，疏言：「毓科非應變之才，適當賊擾，省防尤重。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Governor Yuke and Provincial Treasurer Qing Lian were impeached by censorial officials; Maoqian was ordered to investigate and memorialized: "Yuke lacks the talent to meet emergencies; at a time when bandits are harassing the province, provincial defense is especially important.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Governor Yuke and Provincial Treasurer Qing Lian were impeached by censorial officials. Maoqian was ordered to investigate and reported: "Yuke lacks the talent for crisis management. With bandits raiding the province, provincial defense is especially critical.

sentences.zh: 本境兵勇不敷調遣，辦理未能悉合機宜。

translations.literal: Local troops and braves in the province are insufficient for deployment, and his handling of affairs has not been entirely suited to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: The province lacks enough soldiers and militia to deploy, and his management has not always matched what the situation required.

sentences.zh: 現雖全境肅清，善後急宜妥辦，籌備浙防，接濟皖餉，大局攸關，恐未能措理裕如。

translations.literal: Although the entire area is now pacified, aftercare urgently needs proper arrangement; preparing Zhejiang's defenses and supplying Anhui's pay all concern the overall situation, and I fear he may be unable to handle them with adequate ease.
translations.idiomatic: Although the province is now fully pacified, the aftermath still needs careful handling. Preparing Zhejiang's defenses and supplying Anhui's armies are matters of national importance, and I fear he may not manage them with sufficient ease.

sentences.zh: 慶廉現未到任，無事蹟可考，未敢妄陳。

translations.literal: Qing Lian has not yet taken up his post; there are no deeds to examine, and I dare not speak rashly.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Lian has not yet taken office, so there is no record to judge. I dare not speak beyond what I know.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, the court acknowledged receipt.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was received and noted.

sentences.zh: 任滿，回京，充實錄館副總裁。

translations.literal: When his term expired he returned to the capital and was appointed associate director of the Veritable Records Office.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended he returned to the capital and was appointed associate director of the Veritable Records Office.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，調吏部，擢左都御史。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and promoted to left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and promoted to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 三年，偕大學士瑞常等進講治平寶鑑，授工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the third year, together with Grand Secretary Ruichang and others, he lectured on the Mirror of Governance and Tranquility and was appointed minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined Grand Secretary Ruichang and others in lecturing on the Mirror of Governance and Tranquility and was appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 四年，命赴盛京偕侍郎志和等承修太廟、昭陵工程。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was ordered to go to Mukden, together with Vice Minister Zhihe and others, to undertake repairs on the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the Zhaoling tomb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was ordered to Mukden with Vice Minister Zhihe and others to supervise repairs to the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the Zhaoling tomb.

sentences.zh: 時奉天馬賊猖獗，命懋謙就近查察，劾將軍玉明、府尹德椿，下部議處。

translations.literal: At the time mounted bandits in Fengtian were rampant; Maoqian was ordered to investigate nearby, impeached General Yuming and the prefect De Chun, and the matter was referred to the ministries for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Mounted bandits were then ravaging Fengtian. Maoqian was ordered to investigate on the spot. He impeached General Yuming and Prefect De Chun, and the case was referred to the ministries for action.

sentences.zh: 回京，疏陳馬賊難防，請籌兵餉出邊會剿，以弭盜源。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, he memorialized that mounted bandits were hard to guard against and requested that funds for troops be raised to conduct a joint campaign beyond the border to eliminate the source of banditry.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the capital, he memorialized that mounted bandits were hard to contain and asked that troops and funds be raised for a joint campaign beyond the border to strike at the source of the trouble.

sentences.zh: 又請飭奉天所屬各州縣查勘市鎮鄉村應修堡寨之處，勸民作速興築，擇錄嘉慶年間龔景瀚所著堅壁清野議刊發各州縣，令遵照團練守御之法，量為辦理。

translations.literal: He also requested that the prefectures and counties under Fengtian survey market towns and villages to identify places where fortified stockades should be built, urge the people to erect them speedily, select and print for distribution to each county Gong Jinghan's Treatise on Fortifying Walls and Clearing the Countryside from the Jiaqing reign, and order them to follow militia defense methods as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that Fengtian's prefectures and counties survey their market towns and villages for places where fortified stockades were needed, urge the people to build them quickly, reprint Gong Jinghan's Jiaqing-era Treatise on Fortifying Walls and Clearing the Countryside for local distribution, and organize militia defense accordingly.

sentences.zh: 疏入，均得旨議行。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, each proposal received an edict ordering deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Each proposal was approved by edict and referred to the ministries for implementation.

sentences.zh: 六年，管戶部三庫事務。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was placed in charge of the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was placed in charge of the Ministry of Revenue's three treasuries.

sentences.zh: 七年，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十年，管國子監事務。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was placed in charge of affairs of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was placed in charge of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以吏部尚書協辦大學士，尋拜文淵閣大學士，兼管兵部。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, as minister of personnel he was appointed assistant grand secretary; soon afterward he was appointed grand secretary of the Wenyuan Hall and concurrently placed in charge of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, as minister of personnel he was made assistant grand secretary. Before long he was appointed grand secretary of the Wenyuan Hall and put in charge of the Ministry of War as well.

sentences.zh: 十三年，因久病請解職回籍，允之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, on account of long illness, he requested to resign and return home; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, after a long illness, he asked to resign and return home, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: ，卒於家，詔依例賜卹，有「學問優長，持躬端謹」之褒。

translations.literal: , He died at home; an edict granted condolence payments according to regulation, with praise that "his learning was outstanding and his personal conduct upright and careful."
translations.idiomatic: He died at home. An edict granted the usual funeral honors and praised him for "outstanding learning and upright, careful conduct."

sentences.zh: 贈太子太保，諡文恪。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Wenge.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Wenge.

sentences.zh: 論曰：自咸豐初軍事起，四郊多壘，廟堂旰食。

translations.literal: The commentator says: From the beginning of Xianfeng, as military campaigns arose, fortifications multiplied in the suburbs and the court ate late into the evening with worry.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator writes: From the opening years of Xianfeng, as war spread, fortifications rose on every side and the throne ate its meals late with worry.

sentences.zh: 京師舉辦團防，閣部重臣領之，賈楨、周祖培、朱鳳標皆預其事。

translations.literal: The capital organized militia defense, led by high ministers of the Grand Secretariat and ministries; Jia Zhen, Zhou Zupei, and Zhu Fengbiao all took part.
translations.idiomatic: The capital organized militia defense under leading ministers of the Grand Secretariat and ministries. Jia Zhen, Zhou Zupei, and Zhu Fengbiao all took part.

sentences.zh: 其時用人猶循舊格，揆席多由資進。

translations.literal: At that time appointments still followed the old norms, and most seats in the Grand Secretariat were filled by seniority in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments still followed the old rules then, and most grand secretary seats went to men who had risen by seniority.

sentences.zh: 至穆宗踐阼，底定東南，漢閣臣多取勳望，六官中大拜者鮮，惟單懋謙獨由正卿入閣，時以為榮遇焉。

translations.literal: When the Muzong Emperor ascended the throne and the southeast was pacified, Han Chinese grand secretaries were mostly chosen for their merit and prestige; few among the six ministries received grand appointments, and only Dan Maoqian alone entered the Grand Secretariat from the rank of a chief minister—at the time this was regarded as a signal honor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tongzhi Emperor took the throne and the southeast was pacified, Han grand secretaries were mostly drawn from men of merit and standing. Few holders of the six ministries received grand appointments, and only Dan Maoqian entered the Grand Secretariat from the rank of chief minister—a distinction widely regarded as a singular honor.
